pseudo_record_types.pid: P&ID sheets read into the PLANT layer (P&ID sheet register + sheet reads)
pseudo_record_types.instrument_spec_sheet: Rows of the datasheet register whose sheet_type is instrument_spec_sheet. Sources still declare record_type datasheet.

authority_rule: Each fact kind maps to an ordered list of record types. For a given scope, the first record type in the list that is present for that scope is the authority; later entries apply only where the earlier ones are absent. A record type is present for a scope when a source of that record type is the record for the scope (its scopes list the scope or an enclosing scope; a source that lists no scopes is the record for the scopes of the items its rows resolve to). instrument_spec_sheet is present when such a datasheet source has at least one row with sheet_type instrument_spec_sheet. When no listed record type is present, no record is authoritative there and a disagreement is an authority_gap. settings.authority overrides a default with its own list (or one record type).

datasheet_wide_forms.note: Wide-form templates: one row per item, one column per property. They are an input shape only; the map stores the long datasheet register. Conversion is deterministic: see conversion.
conversion: Every column that is not an identity or trailing column is a property column. Its header is the property name, optionally followed by the unit of measure in square brackets: rated_flow[L/h].
Rows are read top to bottom and property columns left to right. Each non-empty property cell gives one datasheet row; an empty cell gives none.

tag, plant, unit, document and revision are copied from the wide row; property is the header without the bracket; value is the cell exactly as written; uom is the bracket text (empty when there is none).

fact_kind is the one this catalogue gives the property for this form; a column the form does not define gets an empty fact_kind (the default guess applies). sheet_type is the form's sheet_type. cfihos_property is left empty.

locator is the wide row's locator, or 'row N' (N = the line number in the wide file, header = 1) when it is empty, followed by '; column <header>'. status and note are copied to every row made from the wide row.
